texts.text:
ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C2-3,
Motor-Vehicle Related Commercial District; B1-3 Neighborhood Shopping District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 15-G in the area bounded by:

       the alley next north of and parallel to West Rosemont Avenue; the alley next west of and
       parallel to North Winthrop Avenue; West Granville Avenue; the east right-of-way line of
       the Chicago, North Shore and Milwaukee Railroad; the alley next west of and parallel to
       North Winthrop Avenue; West Hollywood Avenue; and the west right-of-way line of the
       Paradise and Pacific Railroad,

to those of a T, Transportation District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          ____________________________
                                                          Leni Manaa-Hoppenworth
                                                          Alderwoman, 48th Ward




Common Addresses:
1118 W. Hollywood Avenue
1119 W. Thorndale Avenue
1122 W. Rosemont Avenue
